_note: Input bindings, applied to InputMap at startup by scripts/autoload/bindings.gd. Edit here, never in the Godot editor's Input Map tab — editor-authored actions land in project.godot and stop being reviewable (ADR 0027). Event syntax: 'key:<name>', 'mouse:<left|right|middle|wheel_up|wheel_down>', 'joybutton:<name>', 'joyaxis:<name><+|->'.
_note_missile: Riding a missile, Space is boost (held) and detonate moves to LMB/X, so a rider never shares a button between the two verbs (ADR 0037). WASD strafe also carries the sandbox fly-cam's cam_* actions, but the fly-cam only exists in sandbox.tscn and the missile only in arena.tscn, so the two never poll in the same scene.
